sample_vertex_features_from_feature_map: sample vertex features from a 2D feature map using bilinear interpolation and normalized vertex coordinates
pool_perceptual_features_for_mesh_vertic: pool perceptual features from image feature maps onto 3D mesh vertices for Mesh R-CNN style processing
sample_features_with_nearest_neighbor_in: sample features from a feature map onto vertices using nearest neighbor interpolation mode
return_packed_vertex_features: sample and return packed vertex features flattened to shape (sum(V), C) for irregular mesh batches
sample_multi_scale_features_onto_vertice: sample and concatenate features from multiple feature maps of different resolutions onto the same set of vertices
